revision.subject: Prepare typed scalar operands for expression execution (#962)

rg.version:
ripgrep 15.2.0

features:+pcre2
simd(compile):+NEON
simd(runtime):+NEON

PCRE2 10.45 is available (JIT is available)

storage.scope: fixture storage only; filesystem syscalls and production VFS remain measured

contract.order: rotate starting participant by task and round
contract.cache: just written, then reused; no flush; discarded correctness-checked warmup round
contract.output: NUL paths, unordered multiset; drained pipe; validation after timing
contract.memory: single-process peak RSS; pipeline sum of individual peaks is an upper bound, not simultaneous peak
contract.scope: batch discovery versus separate precomputed-list filtering; no interactive/ranking equivalence
contract.environment: inherited platform environment; isolated HOME; LC_ALL=C; FZF defaults removed; rg config disabled
contract.children: direct leaf commands only; no shell or unaccounted subprocess trees
contract.depth_rule: deep levels = min(files, depth); broad levels = 0
